title: The box model as a frame jig
label: Frame jig on four feet: a mitred, bevelled moulding (border), stippled mat (padding) and two-layer landscape print with a sun (content), clamped between an L fence and a carriage with a low bellows; dragging changes the width.
caption: With border-box sizing the width you set is the outer frame: drag the carriage and the moulding and mat keep their thickness while the print, the content, gives way, so content is always the width less padding and border.
